title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: No-admission galleries, a no-fee coastal park, and free public-library options in Santa Cruz.

cards.entity_name: UC Santa Cruz Institute of the Arts and Sciences Galleries
cards.title: See art at the IAS Galleries
cards.subtitle: 100 Panetta Ave, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Visit during gallery hours with a friend, take time with the exhibition, and use the adjacent free self-parking if you arrive by car.
cards.short_summary: A UCSC contemporary-art gallery with free exhibitions and public programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The IAS states that all of its exhibitions and public programs are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit — UC Santa Cruz Institute of the Arts and Sciences
cards.access_notes: Wednesday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; the gallery lists free self-parking on Panetta Avenue and High Road.

cards.title: Browse the Sesnon Gallery
cards.subtitle: Porter College, UC Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Plan a quiet gallery stop at Porter College, then discuss one work that caught each person’s attention before heading back across campus.
cards.short_summary: Free public contemporary-art exhibitions in Porter College.
cards.evidence_claim: The Sesnon Gallery says admission is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Visit — Mary Porter Sesnon Art Gallery
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Tuesday–Saturday, noon–5 p.m.; closed Sundays, Mondays, academic holidays, and summer break.

cards.title: Walk Lighthouse Field
cards.subtitle: West Cliff, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Use the daylight hours for a shoreline walk, birdwatching, or a sit on the open headlands; stay on marked routes and observe posted conditions.
cards.short_summary: A no-fee state-beach headland for an ocean-side walk.
cards.evidence_claim: California State Parks lists Lighthouse Field State Beach as having no fees.
cards.source_title: Lighthouse Field State Beach — California State Parks
cards.access_notes: Park hours are 6 a.m. to sunset; the parking lot is open 8 a.m. to sunset.

cards.title: Take a Boardwalk stroll
cards.subtitle: 400 Beach St, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Walk the oceanfront route, look out toward Main Beach, and enjoy the public midway atmosphere without adding rides, games, food, or purchases.
cards.short_summary: An admission-free public stroll along Santa Cruz’s oceanfront amusement park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boardwalk says it is admission-free and free and open to the public for strolling, including when rides are closed.
cards.access_notes: Entry and strolling are free; rides, games, food, and parking can cost extra.

cards.title: Borrow a book downtown
cards.subtitle: 224 Church St, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Bring a California library card, choose a book or media item to share, then set a low-key reading break at the branch during its open hours.
cards.short_summary: A central Santa Cruz library branch where eligible California residents can use a free card.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries says California residents may obtain a library card free of charge and that its services and collections aim to be free to the community.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Circulation Policy
cards.access_notes: A free card requires California residency; confirm branch hours before visiting.

cards.title: Pick a shared read at Garfield Park
cards.subtitle: 705 Woodrow Ave, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Meet at the Garfield Park branch, browse a shelf together with a free eligible card, and leave with a book, comic, or other library item.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood branch for a no-purchase library browse.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries says California residents may obtain a library card free of charge and that its services and collections aim to be free to the community.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Circulation Policy
cards.access_notes: A free card requires California residency; confirm branch hours before visiting.

cards.title: Browse Branciforte’s shelves
cards.subtitle: 230 Gault St, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Use a free eligible library card to browse and borrow together, or choose separate titles and trade brief recommendations before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Cruz branch for free eligible library borrowing.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries says California residents may obtain a library card free of charge and that its services and collections aim to be free to the community.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Circulation Policy
cards.access_notes: A free card requires California residency; confirm branch hours before visiting.

cards.title: Make a no-cost book stop at Live Oak
cards.subtitle: 2380 Portola Dr, Santa Cruz
cards.notes: Bring an eligible free library card, browse a section you do not usually visit, and borrow something for a shared reading or discussion later.
cards.short_summary: A distinct east-side branch for free eligible borrowing.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries says California residents may obtain a library card free of charge and that its services and collections aim to be free to the community.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Circulation Policy
cards.access_notes: A free card requires California residency; confirm branch hours before visiting.

cards.title: Borrow a title at Capitola Library
cards.subtitle: 2005 Wharf Rd, Capitola
cards.notes: Use a free eligible card to check out a book or media item, then compare what each person picked and why it appealed to them.
cards.short_summary: A nearby branch-library outing without a required purchase for eligible cardholders.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries says California residents may obtain a library card free of charge and that its services and collections aim to be free to the community.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Circulation Policy
cards.access_notes: A free card requires California residency; confirm branch hours before visiting.

cards.title: Browse together at Aptos Library
cards.subtitle: 7695 Soquel Dr, Aptos
cards.notes: Bring a free eligible library card, browse a display or collection together, and check out one item each for a later campus conversation.
cards.short_summary: A nearby branch with no purchase required for eligible library-card use.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Cruz Public Libraries says California residents may obtain a library card free of charge and that its services and collections aim to be free to the community.
cards.source_title: Santa Cruz Public Libraries Circulation Policy
